management_remarks: Reliance Industries concluded FY26 with milestone Consolidated Revenue of Rs 10.15 Lakh Crore, EBITDA of Rs 1.82 Lakh Crore, and Net Profit of Rs 79,500 Crore. Jio and Reliance Retail together contributed over 56% of consolidated EBITDA, cementing our transformation into a high-growth consumer and technology platform leader. Cash flows from operations reached Rs 1.74 Lakh Crore against moderating capex of Rs 1.18 Lakh Crore, driving a powerful free cash flow inflection.
analyst_qa: Looking to FY27, while domestic consumer and digital fundamentals are strong, global energy markets remain volatile and petrochemical spreads stay challenging. We remain cautious on working capital expansion in B2B retail and maintain calibrated capex discipline subject to cash flow milestones. Pace of global AI data center monetization remains uncertain amidst moderating global macro growth.
